note: D360: the news-gap short -- a down-gap on abnormal volume in an ordinary name, four cells, three exits, every event taken short, hedged by the floored market; the no-volume arm and the mirror beside; A', B, C on the primary exit; borrow in the net. Per-trade numbers are bp per TRADE and never compared to per-bar numbers. Nothing is a book; nothing promoted.

signal.gap: OPEN[g] / CLOSE[g-1] - 1 on the split-adjusted panel bars
signal.cross_section: elig[g+1] & finite gap & finite rv; V47.percentile_grid (average rank, undefined below 50 names)
signal.exclusions: ex-distribution day (events file amount >= 0.01 x CLOSE[g-1]), zero volume, non-finite prior close
signal.kernel_score: 100 - pct_gap lagged one bar (cap exits); the recovery grid for exit='invalidation' (rec20)
signal.already_held: skipped by the kernel and counted (event_accounting / the recovery replay)

q7.rule: trigger bar g = e0 - 1 with pct_gap[g] <= 2 and pct_rv[g] >= 90

interaction.method: E_sb - E_b - E_s + E_all with E_b the SHORT forward-10 base rate (-forward_excess_grid(h=10)) over eligible name-bars with a defined rsi percentile; bucket = rsi percentile at t-1 of the trigger name at entry
